sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:54

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:54:1
items.html:
Open Your eyes and see, for in AHP there are three times SAG, in Gematria “Pekach” with the kollel, and after them comes the discernment of Einayim: That is, the prayer is in order to set the order straight, so that YHV, which are the Taamim, should be above, and so that SAG, which is in the Einayim and is the joining of the two Heys that are there, should descend below, after the place of the Taamim. For then, after the dot that clung to the Patach in the Einayim descends and the Patach remains without the joining of the bottom Hey, the Einayim are opened in the secret of a Patach. And this is what he says, “and after them comes the discernment of Einayim”
that is, after the Taamim, which are intimated in the Gematria “Pekach.”

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:54:2
items.html: And this is “and see our desolation,” for here there was a great desolation and the annulment of the kings. For through the return of the order to its place, as in the adjacent item, when the bottom Hey descends below and YHV return above, all the great desolation that came about because of the breaking of the vessels is corrected. And this is with all the correction of the vessels that we have today in the world of correction.
